title: Stable source and local binary
content: Source snapshot branch stable-first-local-2026-11-12 points to 7821769eb7aed576dd426ec18ffce3696d93a00d. This is a frozen source-only baseline; matching source for the user's installed Kaffeine binary remains unproven. Never rebuild directly into or replace the working installation.

title: Architecture and provenance
content: TIHULU Media Center packages custom Kaffeine, TV and text/AI features. The archive's legacy installers reference independent development branches and must not be reused unmodified. Do not silently mix source variants or overwrite the upstream TEXT-CENTER project.

title: AI and radio parity
content: Preserve DVB-T2, FM/DAB+, teletext, TV subtitles and AI caption fallback. Independent real hardware and CPU/GPU inference, translation, music and user settings equivalence tests are outstanding; CI fixtures do not establish these.

title: GPL source delivery and licenses
content: Draft PR #23 plans actual binary-plus-corresponding-source provenance and recipient access but has NOT delivered an audited real release. Third-party rights, bundled notices, optional model licensing and complete SBOM remain HOLD.

title: Recovery and uninstall boundaries
content: Disposable CI crash/journal checks have scoped reports; hostile same-UID race, power-loss and owner installed-runtime integrity remain HOLD. No service, model or user-file modifications are authorized.

title: Next safe Codex mission
content: Use isolated documentation and tests only. Confirm the currently reviewed SHA and CI, collect exact blockers, plan but do not execute owner-host acceptance, and keep all old PRs and frozen source unchanged.
